jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a "Director" role providing executive leadership over a senior team of three Deputy Directors and holding ultimate executive responsibility — a senior/executive title far beyond entry-level. The candidate has no full-time or leadership experience, so the level is a hard mismatch despite the human-rights and international-law relevance.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory committee members, not a paid staff role — it seeks established experts (activists and specialists from the named regions) rather than an early-career analyst, and is effectively an unpaid advisory/volunteer position. Although the human-rights and securitisation theme aligns with the candidate's interests, the role is not a genuine paid entry-level vacancy and the candidate lacks the senior expert profile sought.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title and Reprieve's own pay-band placement (Project/Regional Leads/Managers) make this a management-level role well beyond entry-level, and strategic litigation strongly implies a legal qualification the candidate lacks. The human-rights mission is a perfect interest match, but the level and likely qualification are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level coordinator role at an on-mission human-rights organisation, but it is a fundraising / development function that sits outside the candidate's research and policy strengths and does not match their limited dedicated fundraising or campaigns experience. The organisation is a strong interest fit, but the functional mismatch keeps this marginal.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% matched pension

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is a speculative advisory/volunteer position seeking senior subject-matter authorities the candidate is not yet. The human-rights and securitisation subject matter is interesting, but the seniority and non-employment nature are disqualifying.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Communications Physics
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in a physics discipline covered by the journal, which the candidate does not hold and which is entirely outside their field. This is a hard qualification and subject-matter mismatch on every axis.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, BMC Primary Care and BMC Ophthalmology
jobs.reason: Requires a PhD or MD (or equivalent) in a relevant field as an essential, which the candidate does not hold. The role is also in medical/scientific publishing (primary care, ophthalmology), far outside the candidate's background and interests.

jobs.title: Fleming Initiative Policy Fellow
jobs.reason: The role explicitly seeks "an experienced policy professional," and the salary band (£57k–£69k) signals a senior, several-years-experienced fellowship well beyond the candidate's student-assistant/RA background — an unmet essential experience level. The subject (antimicrobial resistance / health policy) also sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Life Sciences
jobs.reason: Requires 8+ years of enterprise sales experience (at least 5 in life-sciences tech sales), far beyond entry-level and a hard disqualifier on both level and experience. It is also an enterprise sales role with no research or policy component, entirely outside the candidate's profile and interests.

jobs.title: Researcher: Climate Change and Inequality (Grant Funded 24-month contract) (AD.08.4)
jobs.reason: The role requires research experience specifically in climate change and climate finance, a Master's in economic development or similar, and a proven track record of designing, implementing and managing research projects plus producing accredited publications — a level of subject-specific experience and independence beyond the candidate's early-career profile and outside their field. The climate/inequality topic also sits outside the candidate's core international-law and atrocity-prevention interests.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.reason: A "Senior" delivery-management title requiring proven experience leading end-to-end delivery of complex software products, agile squad leadership and financial ownership — well beyond entry-level and demanding several years of relevant delivery experience the candidate lacks. It is also a software/agile-delivery role outside the candidate's research and policy background and interest zones.

jobs.title: Nuclear Equipment Surveyor
jobs.reason: This is a senior technical role ("Lead Surveyor", acting as Technical Lead, supervising surveyors and inspectors) requiring nuclear equipment inspection expertise and specific authorisation codes the candidate does not hold. It is a hard mismatch on both level and technical qualification, and sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Nuclear Equipment Surveyor
jobs.reason: This is a senior technical "Lead Surveyor" role in nuclear equipment inspection, requiring engineering competency, authorisation codes, and supervision of surveyors and inspectors — none of which the candidate holds. The title, level, and highly specialised technical field are all hard mismatches with an early-career IR/policy profile.

jobs.title: Media and Planning Lead
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Lead" role requiring substantial team-leadership experience, significant news-strategy / media-relations experience and line management — well beyond entry-level and far above the candidate's student-assistant background. The communications-specialist focus also sits outside the core interest zones and lies in the candidate's weakest skill area.

jobs.title: Brand and Corporate Communications Lead
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Lead" role requiring substantial senior-level communications experience, executive/board advisory experience and a track record of leading mid-sized teams — far beyond entry-level and a hard mismatch on level. It also sits in the communications/brand specialism where the candidate has limited experience and outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: VP Engineering
jobs.reason: This is a VP-level senior engineering leadership role requiring extensive software engineering leadership at scale, deep DevOps/CI-CD/cloud expertise and organisation-design experience — a hard mismatch on both level (executive) and technical skills far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. It is disqualified on the senior-title/experience rule and the deep-technical requirement.

jobs.title: Engineer Surveyor
jobs.reason: Requires an engineering bachelor's degree (Mechanical/Metallurgical/Production) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, plus technical inspection certifications — none of which the candidate holds. This is a senior technical engineering role entirely outside the candidate's academic profile and interest areas.

jobs.title: Programme Manager - Executive Education
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level operational role whose essential requirements centre on programme-delivery management, budget/procurement oversight, live-delivery coordination and providing day-to-day supervision to junior staff — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant experience and clearly not entry-level. The salary band and deputising/people-management scope confirm a mid-level appointment, so the level is a hard mismatch, and executive education sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.
jobs.salary: £43,277 to £51,714 pa (potential to £54,730) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Partnership Strategy & Operations Lead, International
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Lead" role with a preferred 7+ years and essential requirements around RevOps/GTM strategy, SQL/Looker/Tableau/Salesforce, and owning regional commercial plans — well beyond the candidate's early-career, research-oriented profile. The commercial-operations focus also sits outside the candidate's interest zones despite the AI-company setting.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Officer (4252)
jobs.reason: This is an executive-coordination / operational-support role centred on meeting cycles, minute-taking, project management and administering senior-leadership processes — a real but limited match for the candidate's research-and-writing profile, and the salary and "Senior" framing signal experience beyond the candidate's student-assistant background, though no hard 3+ year essential is stated so it stays eligible. Amnesty's human-rights mission is adjacent to the core interests, but the work itself is administrative/executive-support rather than the research or analysis the candidate is aiming for. Location is London (essential requirements met, French/Spanish only desirable), so it survives the filter but sits low on priority.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications Manager
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level role whose minimum criteria require "several years experience" in corporate communications, media relations or public affairs, plus demonstrated experience advising senior leaders — a level and depth of professional experience the candidate lacks. It also sits in a comms-specialist area outside the candidate's core interest zones and specialism.

jobs.title: Account Director – Medical Affairs
jobs.reason: Two hard disqualifiers apply: the role is a senior "Director"-level position requiring proven strategic account-management experience the candidate lacks, and it requires full professional fluency in French as an essential (candidate is only B1). It is also a commercial/sales role in medical communications, well outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Communications and Events Officer
jobs.reason: The role is at an accessible level and the candidate's strong writing and higher-education background transfer, but this is a dedicated communications-and-events specialist post whose essentials — event promotion, CMS/webpage editing, professional social-media analytics — are a real gap given the candidate's limited dedicated comms/events experience. Gender studies is adjacent to the candidate's critical-IR interests but sits outside the core mission zones, so interest pull is moderate and the skills mismatch keeps this marginal.

jobs.title: Open Source Investigators - Contractor - UK
jobs.reason: CIR sits squarely in the candidate's core zone (c) — open-source investigations into human rights abuses and malign influence — and English is the only language essential, so no hard gate applies. However, the essentials ask for a proven OSINT track record plus due-diligence/financial-investigation experience the candidate does not yet have, making this more of a soft stretch than an on-level fit; the interest pull keeps it worth a look despite the experience gap.

jobs.title: Interim Data Availability Lead
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Lead" DBA role requiring 5+ years as a database administrator, plus deep SQL Server, SSIS, Power BI and MS Fabric engineering expertise — well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and non-existent DBA background. Both the level (Lead) and the essential technical requirements are hard disqualifiers, and the IT/database subject is outside all interest zones.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level role requiring proven, experienced digital marketing capability (paid media planning/buying, email programme leadership, multi-channel campaign delivery) — an area where the candidate has no dedicated experience and a level that is not entry-level. The role trips the seniority disqualifier and sits outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant / Teaching Fellow (Law – Options)
jobs.reason: This is a speculative talent-pool posting ("creating a pool of experienced teachers... as and when a suitable teaching opportunity becomes available") with no concrete vacancy, and it seeks experienced teachers to lead law modules — both of which are disqualifiers. Although the human-rights and international-law modules touch the candidate's core interests, teaching law modules also effectively presumes subject-matter mastery the candidate does not have as a non-law IR student.
jobs.salary: From £23.46 per hour (multiplier £56.96–£67.49 for group teaching)

jobs.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant / Teaching Fellow (Law – Core)
jobs.reason: The posting seeks "experienced teachers" for a teaching pool to deliver core law modules (Contract, Criminal, Public, Tort, EU Law) — this is a teaching-fellow role requiring subject-matter expertise and teaching experience the candidate does not have, and it effectively presumes a legal-teaching background. Although the international/EU law subject matter is genuinely interesting, this is a speculative teaching pool for experienced law teachers rather than an entry-level research post.

jobs.title: Content Lead
jobs.reason: This is a "Lead" role requiring substantial experience leading and developing mid-sized teams and significant experience delivering high-profile digital content strategies — well beyond entry-level and disqualifying on both title and required years of experience. It also sits in communications/content, a partial skills gap for the candidate, and outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.reason: Requires a minimum of 3 years of proven sales experience (a hard disqualifier for the candidate's level) and is conducted in Spanish, a language the candidate does not have. It is also a commercial field-sales role entirely outside the candidate's research and policy interests.

jobs.title: Representante de Ventas ELT
jobs.reason: This is a field sales role requiring fluency in Spanish (the entire job is conducted in Spanish, selling to schools in Mexico), which the candidate does not have, plus a valid driving licence and 2 years of field-sales experience. It has no connection to the candidate's research or policy profile and falls outside all interest zones.
